items.title: Old host who accepts 'Rejoin' after a host migration controls a frozen Healer (no movement input is ever sent)
items.evidence: captures/gntcnet3-drops.json data.G_rejoin, reproduced in 2 runs. Setup: host socket closed and refused for 18 s via POST /admin/drop mode close. Guests froze at 72-104 ms and migrated at 10238-10404 ms. The old host's title then showed 'Rejoin XXXXX? Your Healer seat is held for a minute'. After Enter it was a guest in seat 0 within 146-172 ms, synced, and the new host listed it as human (humanSeats [2,0], seat_control@2567). Holding KeyD 2 s moved it 0.00 u on the host and 0.00 u on its own predicted pose. After a canvas click, KeyA 2 s also moved 0.00 u. Every input frame it sent had move:0 (aim did change). Frame: captures/gntcnet3-drops-G-oldhost-rejoined.png ('Online · Healer'). Neither the bot nor the human plays the Healer.
items.reproduce: Start a server with --admin and a preview. Run node tools/gntcnet3-drops.mjs --port <free port> --legs G. The tool opens host + 2 guest pages, sends POST /admin/drop {peerId: host, mode: 'close', forMs: 18000}, waits for migration (~10.3 s), then presses Enter on the old host's 'Rejoin' modal and holds D/A. Check out.data.G_rejoin.rejoin.healerDx.
items.refuters: both refuter lenses reproduced it and ruled it must-fix (round 3)

items.title: Own dodge is mispredicted: the body snaps 1.1-1.8 u back and forth on 25% of dodges at 150 ms RTT (Archer 50%)
items.evidence: captures/gntcnet3-dodge-C150.json, 12 standing dodges per class at lat75,jit10 with no loss: Tank 1/12 (1.22 u), Swordsman 2/12 (1.39 + 1.80 u), Archer 6/12 (pairs of 1.80 u per-frame jumps outside dash frames 200-600 ms after the key). Each snap also raises the game's own correctionSnaps by 2. Some dodges started 160-338 ms late instead of 21-43 ms. captures/gntcnet3-dodge-N0.json (2 ms RTT): 3/36. Soak captures/gntcnet3-soak.json: correctionSnaps seats 2/3 = 10/16 per 3 min at N2 and 1/11 at N1 (Tank 0); net.stats predErrMax 1.04 u (N2) and 1.18 u (N3), 1.58 u at 150 ms with no loss. G5b.2 caps N2/N3 max error at 1.0 u.
items.reproduce: node tools/gntcnet3-dodge.mjs --port <server port> --cond lat75,jit10 --reps 12 --actions Space. It runs a host + 3 guest pages; each guest stands still and presses Space 12 times. Per row, look at 'snaps' and at 'big' entries with dash flag 0.
items.refuters: both refuter lenses reproduced it and ruled it must-fix (round 3)

items.title: Saves on a Level-N setting-out card are described as 'Level N cleared — on the road to the next level' (slot row, Load detail, title Continue)
items.evidence: Prod, pure player path: Level 1 cleared by real input → Quit to Lobby → map table E → Level Select → Level II → Enter. On the card, pause → Load Game shows autosave auto-2 (meta phase transit, level 2, room 0) as 'Autosave · Level II cleared — on the road to the next level', and the detail panel says 'Where: Level II cleared…' (captures/gntcjourney3-prod-O-depart-saves.png; captures/gntcjourney3-journey-prod.json check O1b). A manual Slot 1 saved on the same kind of card reads the same, and the title shows 'Continue · Slot 1 · Level II cleared · just now' (captures/gntcjourney3-dev-departsave-title.png; captures/gntcjourney3-probes-dev.json departSave). Level II was never played. The state itself restores correctly; only the description is wrong (G2.3 metadata / GC.9 / benchmark B9). A clear card (L1→L2) is labelled correctly.
items.reproduce: New Game → clear Level 1 (or campaign.unlock([1,2]) as setup) → walk to the map table, E → Level II → Enter → on the SETTING OUT card press Esc → Save Game → Slot 1 → Esc → Quit to Title → read the Continue caption. Tool: node tools/gntcjourney3-probes.mjs --url <prod> --legs departsave
items.refuters: both refuter lenses reproduced it and ruled it must-fix (round 3)

items.title: Boot dead air: 2.0–4.6 s blank Void-Charcoal page on the production build before any feedback, then a raw camp-scene flash before the splash fades in
items.evidence: CDP screencast on a quiet machine, prod preview (captures/gntcjourney3-bootframes-prod-quiet2.json). Frames at 36 ms (luma 18) and 67 ms (luma 31) are flat colour (…-r1-bootframe-1.png). The next frame, at 2146 ms, is the full live camp render with no overlay (…-r1-bootframe-2.png), and only then does the 'ECHOES · Lighting the hearth…' splash fade in over it (…-r1-bootframe-5.png). On a cold load the first frame appears at 3715 ms. captures/gntcjourney3-boot-prod-quiet.json: FCP 4616 / 1952 / 1780 ms; 'press any key' at 7814 / 3174 / 2984 ms; 592 KB transferred, on localhost. Under concurrent-agent load FCP was 6.6 s and ready 11.7–14.5 s. Benchmark B1 (Hades, Dead Cells and Slay the Spire show a logo or loader within about 1 s) is not met.

items.title: New Game after 'Save & Quit' asks for no confirmation; the saved campaign (held only in the 2-slot autosave rotation) is silently overwritten by the new game's autosaves
items.evidence: captures/gntcjourney3-newgame2-prod.json and captures/gntcjourney3-newgame-prod.json. Campaign A reached Level 1 room 4 (Glint 36, seed 2575734311). Pause → Save & Quit ('Your run is written to the autosave slot first') → title shows 'Continue — Autosave · Level I · The Hollow Wood · Room 4'. New Game opens no dialog (stack [] → playing). Campaign B then starts: after room 2, auto-1 holds campaign B (seed 1110681614); after room 3, auto-2 holds campaign B too (autosaveLog room_enter writes at 50.2 s and 84.7 s). Campaign A is gone with no warning. This breaks PLAN §0 'state is never silently lost' and benchmark B4 (Slay the Spire asks 'Abandon run?').
items.reproduce: Title → New Game → Begin Run → play to room 3–4 → Esc → Save & Quit to Title → confirm → on the title move Down to New Game → Enter (no dialog) → Begin Run → play 2 rooms (at least ~35 s apart, the autosave throttle) → Load Game: the old campaign's autosave no longer exists. Tool: node tools/gntcjourney3-newgame2.mjs http://127.0.0.1:
items.refuters: both refuter lenses reproduced it and ruled it must-fix (round 3)
